title: Implement POST /api/email/send and GET /api/email/sent routes
description: Create the API routes for sending outreach emails and listing sent email records. Uses the email factory to route to mock or live Resend based on EMAIL_MODE.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/email/send accepts { prospectSlug, templateId, subject, previewText } body
Sends email via the email factory (respects EMAIL_MODE)
Creates a sent_emails record on success
GET /api/email/sent returns array of sent email records with prospect info
Verify by sending a test email and checking the DB

steps.details: Export POST handler. Load prospect by slug. Load template by id. Call `emailFactory.send({ to, subject, body })`. Insert record into sent_emails table. Return { sent: true, mode }.
Export GET handler. Query sent_emails joined with prospects. Return array with id, prospectSlug, businessName, sentAt, subject, mode.
POST /api/email/send with a valid prospectSlug and templateId. Verify 200 response and DB record. GET /api/email/sent and verify the record appears.
